name: José Carlos Monteiro
source:
José Carlos, also known as Zeca, is the fiancée of Lucinda.
He's 37 years old and works as a teacher at high school in São Vicente, but originally, he's from Brava.
Zeca seems to have low self-esteem and often has pessimistic behavior.

[From [url=https://gongonstudio.itch.io/a-kiss-from-death]itch.io[/url]]
